description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] Team 7 (without Kakashi) is given a mission to protect a young man, Idate, during his foot race against a rival clan that will settle the feud between the two. They are known as the Wasabi family and the Wagarashi family. Idate, however, has a strong distaste for ninja, and always ends up arguing with Naruto.

intro.fallback: Team 7 (without Kakashi) is given a mission to protect a young man, Idate, during his foot race against a rival clan that will settle the feud between the two.
They are known as the Wasabi family and the Wagarashi family.
Idate, however, has a strong distaste for ninja, and always ends up arguing with Naruto.

name.fallback: Mission: Help an Old Friend in the Land of Tea

text.fallback: Head out: Mission: Help an Old Friend in the Land of Tea

outro.fallback: Just like the Wasabi clan hired ninja to protect their runner, the Wagarashi clan did the same.
In the opening of the race, Idate runs off in the wrong direction, confusing everyone.
